glosses: affirmation (form of self-forced meditation or repetition)
That which is affirmed; a declaration that something is true.

examples.text: Her success was an affirmation of all her hard work.
The ceremony included an affirmation of loyalty.

glosses: A solemn pledge (to tell the truth, to bear allegiance, etc.), legally equivalent to an oath, taken by people who are forbidden to take a religious oath (such as Quakers) or otherwise prefer not to do so.
A form of self-forced meditation or repetition; autosuggestion.

examples.text: Daily positive affirmations can improve self-confidence.
